---
title: "My Resume"
resources:
  - files/resume.pdf
  - files/pdfjs/*
---

::: {.resume-actions}
[Download PDF](files/resume.pdf){.btn .btn-primary download="Ben_Hsu_Resume.pdf"}
[Open in new tab](files/resume.pdf){.btn .btn-outline-secondary target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
:::

```{=html}
<div id="resume-viewer" class="resume-viewer" aria-label="Resume preview">
  <p class="resume-loading">Loading resume preview…</p>
</div>
<noscript>
  <object data="files/resume.pdf" type="application/pdf" width="100%" height="800">
    <a href="files/resume.pdf">Download the resume (PDF)</a>
  </object>
</noscript>
<script src="files/pdfjs/pdf.min.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  var container = document.getElementById("resume-viewer");
  var url = "files/resume.pdf";

  function fallback() {
    container.innerHTML =
      '<object data="' + url + '" type="application/pdf" width="100%" height="800">' +
      '<p>Preview is unavailable in this browser. <a href="' + url + '">Download the resume (PDF)</a>.</p>' +
      "</object>";
  }

  if (!window.pdfjsLib) { fallback(); return; }
  pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = "files/pdfjs/pdf.worker.min.js";

  var pdfDoc = null;
  function renderAll() {
    if (!pdfDoc) return;
    container.innerHTML = "";
    var width = container.clientWidth;
    var ratio = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    var chain = Promise.resolve();
    for (var n = 1; n <= pdfDoc.numPages; n++) {
      (function (pageNum) {
        chain = chain.then(function () {
          return pdfDoc.getPage(pageNum).then(function (page) {
            var base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
            var scale = width / base.width;
            var vp = page.getViewport({ scale: scale * ratio });
            var canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
            canvas.className = "resume-page";
            canvas.width = vp.width;
            canvas.height = vp.height;
            canvas.style.width = "100%";
            canvas.setAttribute("aria-label", "Resume page " + pageNum);
            container.appendChild(canvas);
            return page.render({ canvasContext: canvas.getContext("2d"), viewport: vp }).promise;
          });
        });
      })(n);
    }
    return chain;
  }

  var guard = setTimeout(function () { if (!pdfDoc) fallback(); }, 12000);
  pdfjsLib.getDocument(url).promise.then(function (doc) {
    clearTimeout(guard);
    pdfDoc = doc;
    return renderAll();
  }).catch(fallback);

  var t;
  window.addEventListener("resize", function () {
    clearTimeout(t);
    t = setTimeout(renderAll, 250);
  });
})();
</script>
```
